name: Nordea Bank Abp
blurb: Nordea Bank Abp is a leading Nordic financial services group offering banking products and services to individuals, families, and businesses across Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, and internationally. It operates through Personal Banking, Business Banking, Large Corporates & Institutions, and Asset & Wealth Management segments. The company provides a wide range of financial services via mobile banking, online, phone, and branch offices, including payments, cash management, cards, and working capital solutions. With a market capitalization of approximately €52.8 billion and over 28,700 employees, Nordea is one of the largest banks in the Nordic region.
recent: In the past 30 days, Nordea's stock has traded in a range of €15.52–€15.65, with a 52-week range of €11.97–€17.11. The company reported a trailing twelve-month revenue of €11.58 billion and net income of €4.71 billion, with an EPS of €1.36. The next earnings date is scheduled for April 22, 2026.
